context: Grading a response about tracking ~/.aws/credentials with chezmoi safely.

checklist.name: flags_private_insufficient
checklist.description: Response explicitly states that `private_` alone (permissions only) is not sufficient protection for a secret file.

checklist.name: recommends_encrypted_prefix
checklist.description: Response recommends the `encrypted_` prefix or `chezmoi add --encrypt`.

checklist.name: explains_git_history_risk
checklist.description: Response explains that plaintext committed without encryption remains recoverable from git history even after later removal.

checklist.name: no_plain_tracking_suggested
checklist.description: Response does not suggest tracking the credentials file as a plain or private_-only file.
